system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: atma_get_fertilizer_recommendation and atma_get_crop_plan. Here are my details: my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_2763, my location is dummy_location_2894, my growth_stage is dummy_growth_stage_7251.

function.name: atma_get_crop_plan
function.description: Generates a full-season crop plan with stage-wise milestones, input schedule, and expected yield. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee yield outcomes. Fails if crop-location combination is unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: atma_get_fertilizer_recommendation
function.description: Provides fertilizer and input recommendations based on crop type, growth stage, and soil conditions. Requires session_token. Does NOT apply inputs or modify soil data. Fails if crop-stage combination is invalid or insufficient data.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
